There is a bit of a void from Tobias leaving and how much he meant to us, but that means there’s opportunities for other guys. JD is a leader on this team. Ausar is growing to be a leader on this team."

items.title: October 23, 1986: Houston's Akeem Olajuwon scored 23 PTS and Jim Petersen had 20 PTS/9 REB in the Rockets' 113-101 preseason win over the 76ers in Lafayette, Louisiana.
items.author: NBA Cobwebs
items.body_excerpt:
October 23, 1986: Houston's Akeem Olajuwon scored 23 PTS and Jim Petersen had 20 PTS/9 REB in the Rockets' 113-101 preseason win over the 76ers in Lafayette, Louisiana.

Julius Erving scored 16 PTS and Jeff Ruland had 16 PTS/7 REB for Philadelphia.
